equity_bridge.item: Long-term equity investments (JVs/associates) at 75% of book
equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 consolidated balance sheet RMB12,584m; JV/associate income (RMB664m FY2025) is excluded from projected EBIT, so the asset goes in the bridge. 25% haircut because it includes loss-making EV JVs (e.g. Spotlight with BMW) carried at book.
H1 2026 balance sheet; fair-value income excluded from EBIT.

Accounts payable 39.4bn + notes payable 41.7bn = ~160 days of cost of sales at 30/6/2026. Part of the net cash is supplier float; GWM joined the June 2025 industry pledge to pay suppliers within 60 days and H1 2026 shows payables migrating into bank-acceptance notes rather than shrinking. An expected-value deduction of ~8bn (roughly 15-16 days of COGS) is taken once here rather than in any scenario's working-capital path.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 8.9% vs revenue 5yr CAGR 16.6% (diverges >30%): revenue growth has been bought at falling margins (net margin 5.2% FY2020 -> 4.4% FY2025 -> 2.4% H1 2026) and ~40-50% dividend payouts.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs are not meaningful: the FY2020 and FY2022 bases are negative and the series swings with bill-financing working capital (FY2025 +15.6bn receivables release). SBC is small (0.1-0.8% of revenue) so the owner-FCF vs reported-FCF CAGR gap is not the issue here; working capital is. H1 2026 revenue +10.6% YoY to 102.1bn, net profit -61% to 2.46bn.

scenario_narratives.base: Exports keep carrying the group: overseas volume grows from ~0.5m to ~0.7m units in FY2026 and on through Brazil and Thailand localisation, while the domestic market stays a grind. The price war neither resolves nor deepens; pickups and TANK off-roaders hold their niche margins, ORA/WEY NEVs earn little. Group EBITDA settles at ~9.5% (EBIT ~4%), giving roughly FY2025-level profit of ~RMB10bn on a larger revenue base by FY2028 -- management's FY2026 ~10bn target arrives about two years late.
scenario_narratives.bull: Regulator-led discipline ends the domestic price war in 2027 and the Hi4 hybrid family plus GWM ONE platform win share in the RMB100-200k band; export volumes compound past 1m units with localised plants dodging tariffs and Russia recycling-fee rebates finally paid. Margins recover to and slightly below the FY2024 peak (EBITDA 11%), revenue compounds ~6% for five years, and the A/H discount is irrelevant because the cash returns come through dividends.
scenario_narratives.bear: The price war runs through 2028 and BYD's vertically integrated cost base forces GWM to discount into its pickup and SUV niches; the EU, Brazil and Russia tighten tariffs and recycling fees just as exports become more than half of volume, so revenue stalls and falls in 2028. EBITDA drops to ~7% (EBIT ~1.6%), heavy direct-to-user selling costs fail to pay back, and governance concentration (Wei Jianjun controls ~55-60% via Baoding Great Wall Holdings) keeps capital allocation geared to volume rather than returns.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on CNY flows at a CNY-built 10% WACC, converted to HKD for comparison with the H-share price. The striking feature is the balance sheet: RMB~51bn of net cash and wealth-management products (after excluding restricted deposits) against an H-share-implied market capitalisation of RMB~51bn, before any value for the operating business or JV stakes. Most of the per-share value therefore rests on (a) that cash being genuinely shareholders' rather than supplier float -- partly addressed by an 8bn float-normalisation deduction -- and (b) GWM earning thin but positive owner FCF through the price war. The A share trades at ~2.3x the H share for identical rights; the model values both classes the same.
key_risks_to_valuation: Net cash is partly supplier float: ~160 days of payables (accounts + bank-acceptance notes); stricter payment-term enforcement could absorb well more than the 8bn reserved.
Price-war margin compression: every 1pp of EBITDA margin is ~RMB2.5bn/yr of pre-tax cash flow.
Export/tariff concentration: overseas >40% of revenue and >50% of volume; EU/Brazil tariffs and Russian recycling fees.
Controlling-shareholder governance and the persistent A/H discount mean H-share holders may never see the value except via dividends.
Earnings quality: FY2025 profit included ~1.6bn FX gains and 4.0bn of other income (subsidies); H1 2026 shows how quickly both can reverse.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 6.83-16.75 HKD. A-share 601633.SS and CNYHKD=X from the same API for the parity check in inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: 2333.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2018-H1 FY2026, CNY millions); FY2025 Annual Report (income statement, cash flow statement and supplementary reconciliation, note XIII.3 SBC); H1 2026 Interim Report (consolidated balance sheet at 30/6/2026, note VI.2 held-for-trading assets, note VI.26 current portion of non-current liabilities, cash-flow reconciliation, H-share repurchases).
data_sources.qualitative: 2333.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-18): price war, export/tariff exposure, governance, Hi4 platform, FY2026 informal guidance and broker targets.

inputs.share_count_basis: Share capital 8,553.42m at 30/6/2026 (A 6,234.64m + H 2,318.78m) less 11.08m H shares repurchased June 2026 and 0.35m July 2026 held as treasury = 8,542.0m. Diluted EPS equals basic in H1 2026 (options and the Changqi convertible are out of the money), so basic = fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. A and H shares carry identical economic rights, so one per-share value applies to both classes.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report note XIII.3 'Share-based payment expense for the year' RMB225.83m (restricted stock 143.50m + options 82.34m); FY2024 RMB540.8m, FY2023 RMB372.5m from the same note. No separate equity-award withholding tax disclosed.
inputs.fx_note: 1 CNY = 1.1724 HKD, Yahoo CNYHKD=X, quote time 2026-10-16T22:01Z. All flows and per-share values computed in CNY and converted to HKD at this rate; weighted_iv (unsuffixed) is HKD. Parity check against the dual listing: A share 601633.SS RMB14.03 (2026-10-16 close) = HK$16.45 vs H share HK$7.045, i.e. the A/H premium is ~133%. The two classes are economically identical, so this is a market-segmentation discount on the H line, not an FX-direction error (the HKD/CNY direction is confirmed by H price HK$7.045 = RMB6.01).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo chart API; 52-week range 6.83-16.75
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY: China 10y government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x 7.0% China ERP = ~10.2% cost of equity; the group is net cash, so WACC ~ cost of equity. 10.0% used for all three scenarios. Cyclical, price-war, tariff and governance risk is carried in the scenario paths and the 30% bear weight, not stacked as a WACC premium (adaptations 7f). Terminal growth 2.0% base reflects low CNY nominal growth; cap 12x FCF because autos are cyclical.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease_cost_pct_path 0.9% of revenue (H1 2026 right-of-use amortisation RMB893m = 0.87% of revenue, plus lease interest) is charged inside EBIT; da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use (FY2025 9.78bn = 4.4%, H1 2026 4.64bn = 4.5%); lease liabilities (RMB1,776m non-current + 1,580m current = 3,356m) are EXCLUDED from total_debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: None needed: minority interests are nil at 30/6/2026 and FY2025 (consolidated NCI line is '-').
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, three scenarios, 10-year horizon -- GWM is a manufacturing operating company (one segment: autos and parts), routed to owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md (non-US, cyclical, CNY/HKD dual currency, IFRS-16-style leases under CAS, near-SBC-zero). No prior DCF and no MEMORY.md entry, so this is a fresh build. NET CASH: total_debt 10,879 = short-term borrowings 5,770 + long-term borrowings 13 + long-term loans due within one year 1,277 + bonds due within one year 3,817 (incl. Changqi convertible) + other 2; cash 61,729 = cash and bank balances 30,641 LESS restricted security/margin deposits for bank acceptances 3,008 (they back operating notes payable) + held-for-trading wealth-management/monetary-fund products 34,096 (H1 2026 note VI.2). Interest income and WMP returns are excluded from projected EBIT because the assets sit in the bridge. LAST_FCF CAVEAT: FY2025 reported FCF 28.8bn (OCF 40.4bn - capex 11.5bn) is flattered by a RMB15.6bn release of operating receivables (bill financing run-off); pre-working-capital cash earnings were ~21bn and normalised owner FCF ~9-10bn. Projections are built from components and do NOT start from last_fcf. CAPEX includes capitalised development spend (FY2025 4.5bn, 43% of R&D) -- 'cash payments to purchase and construct fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets'. EBITDA DEFINITION: revenue - operating costs - taxes and levies - selling - admin - R&D - asset/credit impairments + other income (government/overseas tax-policy subsidies) + D&A; excludes financial expenses (FY2025 included a ~1.6bn FX gain), investment income and fair-value gains. FY2025 = 9.0%, FY2024 = 11.5%, H1 2026 = ~8.0% (other income fell from 3.0bn to 0.48bn as overseas tax-policy subsidies were deferred). BUYBACKS: HK$114m (RMB~97.5m) of H shares in June 2026 plus HK$3m in July, held in treasury; the flat count is only lightly funded by actual repurchases. FY2026 GUIDANCE (informal, via broker summaries): >=1.8m units, net profit ~RMB10bn, exports ~700k; base case does not take the 10bn profit at face value (H1 was 2.46bn).

historical_owner_fcf.note: reported FCF - SBC - interest income, RMB m. FY2019 SBC n/a (pre-scheme, ~0). The series swings sign with working capital (bill financing, payables), which is why CAGRs on it are not meaningful.

base.growth_rates_rationale: FY2026 +9% (H1 +10.6%, exports +45% offsetting a -6% domestic market), fading to 2.5% as export growth matures and tariff walls rise.
base.ebitda_margin_path_rationale: FY2026 8.6% = H1 ~8.0% plus a modest H2 recovery as deferred overseas subsidies are recognised; mature 9.5% sits between FY2025 9.0% and FY2024 11.5%, i.e. EBIT ~4.1% after 0.9% lease and 4.5% D&A -- roughly FY2025-level net profit (~10bn) on a larger revenue base.
base.capex_pct_path_rationale: FY2025 5.2%, FY2024 5.9%, H1 2026 5.9% (incl. capitalised R&D); glides to 4.8% vs 4.5% D&A as the Brazil/Thailand build-out completes.
base.cash_tax_rate_path_rationale: FY2025 effective 16.1% (15% HNTE rate plus R&D super-deduction, higher overseas rates); 18% allows for the overseas mix rising.
base.wc_capture_pct_rationale: Zero: GWM runs negative working capital (payables > receivables + inventory), but payment-term regulation makes further float from growth unreliable; the level risk is charged once in the equity_bridge.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default because the China price war shows no sign of resolving (H1 2026 net profit -61% with revenue +11%) and exports now concentrate trade-policy risk outside management's control. Base 50% as the central path of export-led growth at FY2025-like margins. Bull cut to 20% because it needs two independent things -- domestic price discipline and tariff-free export compounding -- to go right together.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
